# Travel Cancellation Policy
        
        ## Overview
        This document outlines the cancellation policies for hotel reservations, car rental reservations, and packaged trip bookings managed by our travel company.
        
        ---
        
        ## 1. Hotel Reservation Cancellation
        
        - **Cancellation Fee:** A flat fee of **$50** is charged per hotel reservation cancellation.
        - **Eligibility:** Only existing hotel reservations in the system (world.db) can be cancelled.
        - **Process:** The cancellation must be confirmed through the reservation back-office system. The fee is assessed at the time of cancellation confirmation.
        
        ---
        
        ## 2. Car Rental Reservation Cancellation
        
        - **Cancellation Fee:** A flat fee of **$25** is charged per car rental reservation cancellation.
        - **Eligibility:** Only existing car rental reservations in the system (world.db) can be cancelled.
        - **Process:** The cancellation must be confirmed through the reservation back-office system. The fee is assessed at the time of cancellation confirmation.
        
        ---
        
        ## 3. Packaged Trip Booking Cancellation
        
        - **Cancellation Fee:** **10% of the total trip price** is charged as a cancellation fee for packaged trip bookings.
        - **Eligibility:** Only existing packaged trip bookings in the system (world.db) can be cancelled.
        - **Process:** The cancellation must be confirmed through the reservation back-office system. The percentage-based fee is calculated from the total booking price at the time of cancellation confirmation.
        
        ---
        
        ## General Notes
        
        - All cancellation fees are non-refundable.
        - Cancellations must be processed through the company's reservation back-office system.
        - Customers should verify their reservation details before requesting a cancellation.
        - For any questions or disputes regarding cancellation fees, please contact customer support.
        
        ---
        
        *This policy is subject to change. Please check for the latest version before making cancellation decisions.*

### ✈️ Flight Cancellation
| Cabin / Route | Fee |
|---|---|
| Any class — within free window (24h domestic / 48h international) | **Free** (full refund) |
| Basic Economy — after free window | **Not cancellable** (unless insured) |
| Economy — Domestic | **max($50, 15% of ticket price)** |
| Economy — International | **max($75, 20% of ticket price)** |
| Business — Domestic | **5% of ticket price** |
| Business — International | **8% of ticket price** |
| First Class | **Free cancellation** |

### 🏨 Hotel Cancellation
| Timing | Fee |
|---|---|
| ≥ 48 hours before check-in (Standard) | **Free** |
| 24–48 hours before check-in (Standard) | **50% of first night** |
| < 24 hours before check-in (Standard) | **Full first night charge** |
| Suite bookings | **Non-refundable** (full charge) |

### 🚗 Car Rental Cancellation
| Timing | Fee |
|---|---|
| ≥ 24 hours before pickup | **Free** |
| < 24 hours before pickup | **One day rental charge** |
| Luxury / SUV rentals | **Additional $50 surcharge** at all times |

The full detailed policy document (including change, baggage, delay compensation, loyalty, and upgrade policies) is saved at `docs/travel_cancellation_policy.md` for your future reference.
